description: Two independent lenders draw against the same fresh 100,000 claim in sequence: Lender A takes 70,000 (succeeds, leaving 30,000 available), then Lender B requests 50,000 (rejected -- 50,000 was well within the original 100,000 capacity, but not within what's left after A). This is the exact PRD money-shot scenario (Appendix E / J2): first applied wins, second is rejected, on-chain and recomputable, not a UI check.
note: Claim state built on the real Gate 1 stream, starting fully undrawn. Both lender addresses are synthetic placeholders; the draw amounts (70,000 then 50,000) are the PRD's own documented demo numbers.
